blocks.en: Abstract
blocks.zh: 摘要

blocks.en: Audio-visual question answering on lightweight user devices requires balancing speed, memory usage, privacy, and communication. One approach is to run audio-visual encoders on a server and a lightweight language decoder on the user device, keeping questions local while offloading media encoding. However, transferring and processing the full multimodal representation remains costly. We propose a training-free, query-agnostic token pruning framework that constructs a compact, reusable memory before transmission. We define video spatio-temporal blocks and aligned audio windows as players and estimate their importance through Monte Carlo Shapley valuation. We use an embedding coverage objective that combines query-independent utility with cross-modal redundancy calibration and rewards unimodal diversity through marginal coverage gains. We retain the original token embeddings of high-scoring players under a limited token budget and transfer the resulting memory once for reuse across subsequent local questions. Experiments on Video-MME, Daily-Omni, and Video-Holmes using video-SALMONN 2+ (3B) and video-SALMONN 2 Pro (4B) show that our method achieves the best or tied-best QA accuracy among the compared compression methods across all evaluated settings. On Daily-Omni with video-SALMONN 2+ (3B) at 80\% pruning, our method improves accuracy by 12.86--14.62 percentage points over these methods while achieving the lowest device-side LLM prefill and decoding latency, with up to $1.92\times$ decoding speedup at comparable embedding memory usage.
blocks.zh: 关于轻量级用户设备的视听问题回答需要平衡速度、内存使用、隐私和通信。 一种方法是在服务器上运行视听编码器,在用户设备上运行轻量级语言解码器,在卸载媒体编码时保留局部问题. 然而,转让和处理完整的多式联运代表仍然费用高昂。 我们建议建立一个无培训、无查询、不可知的代号搜索框架,在传输前构建一个可重复使用的紧凑内存。 我们把视频时空块和对齐的音频窗口定义为玩家,并通过Monte Carlo Shapley估值估计其重要性. 我们采用嵌入式覆盖目标,将查询-独立效用与跨模式冗余校准相结合,并通过边际覆盖收益奖励单一模式的多样性。 我们保留了高分球员在有限象征性预算下嵌入的原始地标,并将由此产生的内存一次性转出,再用于以后的局部问题。 使用视频-SALMONN 2+(3B)和视频-SALMONN 2 Pro(4B)进行Video-MME、Daily-Omni和Video-Holmes的实验表明,我们的方法在所有被评价的场合的比较压缩方法中实现了最佳或捆绑最佳的QA精度。 我们的方法比这些方法提高了12.86-14.62个百分点,同时实现了最低设备侧LLM预填和解码层,在相似的嵌入内存使用中,解码速度可达1.92\times$。

blocks.en: 1 Introduction
blocks.zh: 导言

blocks.en:
Interactive media services permit viewers to seek explanations and information about what they are watching.
Second-screen companion applications support this need by providing content-related information on personal devices alongside a shared display [ 10 ] .
Conversational question answering helps viewers better understand video content and can further support accessibility, as illustrated by recent interfaces for blind and low-vision viewers [ 3 ] .
For these interactions, answering questions locally can help protect privacy by keeping viewers’ questions and responses on their devices.
Apple’s Foundation Models framework illustrates this possibility by supporting on-device language processing without sending user inputs to a server [ 2 ] .
blocks.zh:
互动媒体服务允许观众了解他们正在观看什么。
第二屏幕辅助应用程序支持这一需要,方法是在共享显示器的同时在个人设备上提供内容相关信息[10].
对话问答帮助观众更好地理解视频内容,并能进一步支持无障碍,最近盲人和低视线观众的界面就说明了这一点[3].
对于这些互动,当地回答问题可以帮助保护隐私,将观众的问答保留在他们的设备上.
Apple's Foundation Models框架通过在不向服务器发送用户输入[2]的情况下支持device语言处理来说明这种可能性.

为了构建紧凑的内存,我们提出一种新颖的符号选择方法.
图2概述了我们的框架和拟议方法。

blocks.en:
Multimodal foundation models [ 17 , 29 , 20 ] offer a natural way to answer viewers’ questions about audio-visual content.
However, deploying this capability involves a trade-off between privacy and device resources.
On the one hand, processing everything on a server requires transmitting users’ questions and potentially personal context beyond their devices, raising privacy concerns and incurring additional communication overhead through repeated question–response exchanges.
On the other hand, running the entire model locally places substantial computational and memory demands on lightweight devices, particularly for long-form video and audio.
Building on prior work on partitioning multimodal models across devices [ 28 ] , we consider a collaborative deployment to address these concerns (see Fig. 1 ): a server or playback host runs the audio-visual encoders, while each user’s device runs a lightweight language decoder.
This division allows the host to encode the media once and the device to reuse the resulting features across questions without sending user queries to the server.
Even with the encoders offloaded, long-form content can produce a large number of multimodal tokens.
Transferring these tokens consumes bandwidth, while storing and processing them increases device memory usage and inference latency, making communication and computation joint considerations [ 15 ] .
The central challenge is therefore to reduce the size of the transferred representation while preserving the evidence needed to answer users’ questions.
blocks.zh:
多式联运基础模型[17、29、20]为回答观众关于视听内容的问题提供了一个自然的方法。
然而,这种能力的部署需要隐私与设备资源之间的权衡。
一方面,处理服务器上的一切需要将用户的问题和潜在的个人背景传送到其设备之外,引起对隐私的担忧,并通过反复的问答交流引起额外的通信间接。
另一方面,在当地运行整个模型对轻量级设备,特别是长式视频和音频设备,提出了大量的计算和内存要求.
基于先前关于跨设备的多式联运模式划分[28]的工作,我们考虑合作部署,以解决这些关切(见图1):一个服务器或播放主机运行视听编码器,而每个用户的设备运行一个轻量级语言解码器。
此分区允许主机对媒体编码一次,并允许设备在不向服务器发送用户查询的情况下重复使用所产生的特性。
即使将编码器卸载下来,长式内容也能产生大量多式联运标志.
转移这些令牌会消耗带宽,同时存储和处理它们会增加设备内存的使用和推论延迟,使通信和计算联合考虑[15].
因此,主要的挑战是缩小所转移的代表人数,同时保留回答用户问题所需的证据。

blocks.en:
Pruning visual and audio tokens before they enter the device-side LLM offers a way to reduce both communication and local inference costs.
However, several existing approaches rely on information unavailable during server-side memory construction.
Query-guided methods such as PruneVid [ 14 ] require the user’s question, whereas our setting keeps questions and personal context on the device.
Pruning inside the device-side LLM, as in FastV [ 4 ] , leaves the initial token transfer unchanged and still requires processing the input through the layers preceding pruning.
These approaches therefore cannot directly construct a query-agnostic memory for one-time transfer and reuse across future questions.
Pre-LLM compression methods provide applicable building blocks, but selecting complementary audio-visual evidence remains a key challenge.
OmniZip [ 22 ] uses audio retention to guide video token allocation and cross-modal similarity to consolidate audio anchors.
However, high cross-modal similarity may also indicate duplicated evidence.
When audio and video convey the same information, retaining both may consume budget without adding much coverage.
Whether prioritizing such shared evidence best preserves information for unknown questions therefore remains an open question.
blocks.zh:
在进入设备侧LLM前运行视觉和音频信号符,提供了一个既降低通信成本又降低本地推论成本的方法.
然而,有几种现有方法依赖于服务器侧内存构建过程中无法获得的信息.
PruneVid [14] 等查询指导方法需要用户提问, 而我们的设置则将问题和个人背景保留在设备上 。
运行在设备侧LLM内部,如FastV [4]中,将初始的符号传输保留不变,仍然需要通过运行前的层处理输入.
因此,这些方法不能直接构建一个查询-不可知存储器,用于一次性转移和再利用未来的问题。
LLM前压缩方法提供了适用的构件,但选择补充视听证据仍然是一个关键的挑战.
OmniZip [22] 使用音频保留来指导视频符号分配和跨模式相似来整合音频主播.
然而,高跨模式的相似性也可能表明重复的证据。
当音频和视频传达相同信息时,保留两者可能会消耗预算,而不会增加很多报道。
因此,确定此类共享证据的优先顺序是否最好地为未知问题保存信息仍然是一个未决问题。

blocks.en:
To address these challenges, we propose a training-free, query-agnostic framework that constructs a compact audio-visual memory before transmission to the user device.
We organize video tokens into spatio-temporal blocks and audio tokens into aligned temporal windows, treating each group as a player.
Rather than scoring players in isolation, we evaluate their average marginal contributions to an embedding coverage objective through Monte Carlo Shapley estimation.
The objective combines embedding-based utility with cross-modal redundancy calibration, while encouraging unimodal diversity through coverage.
This formulation assigns less additional credit to already represented content and downweights evidence duplicated across modalities.
The selected groups preserve their original token embeddings, forming a reusable memory that is transferred once.
A lightweight on-device decoder then answers subsequent questions using this memory, reducing communication and local processing costs while keeping user questions on the device.
blocks.zh:
为了应对这些挑战,我们建议在传送给用户设备之前,建立一个无培训、查询-不可知性框架,构建一个紧凑的视听记忆。
我们把视频信号组织成spitio-timperal的块,把音频信号组织成对齐的时间窗口,把每个组当作一个玩家.
我们不是孤立地对参与者进行评分,而是通过蒙特卡洛·沙普利估计,评估他们对嵌入覆盖目标的平均边际贡献。
目标将嵌入式效用与跨模式冗余校准相结合,同时通过覆盖面鼓励单一模式的多样性。
这种提法对已经表示的内容给予较少的额外抵免,对不同模式重复的证据给予较低的加权。
被选中的组保留其原始的符号嵌入,形成可重复使用的内存,一次传输.
轻量级的device解码器然后用这个内存回答后续的问题,降低通讯和本地处理成本,同时将用户问题保留在设备上.

blocks.en:
Our contributions are threefold: • We formulate audio-visual token pruning as query-agnostic memory construction at the server–device interface.
The compact memory supports one-time transfer and repeated local question answering while keeping user queries on the device. • We develop a training-free framework that treats structured audio-visual token groups as players and estimates their marginal contributions through Monte Carlo Shapley valuation.
Its embedding coverage objective combines modality-specific utility and cross-modal redundancy calibration, encouraging unimodal diversity and complementary evidence under a restricted token budget. • We evaluate our framework on Video-MME, Daily-Omni, and Video-Holmes using video-SALMONN 2+ (3B) and video-SALMONN 2 Pro (4B), achieving the best or tied-best QA accuracy across all settings.
On Daily-Omni with video-SALMONN 2+ (3B) at 80% pruning, our method outperforms competing compression methods by 12.86–14.62 percentage points.
In this setting, it also achieves the lowest device-side LLM prefill and decoding latency, with up to 1.92 × 1.92\times decoding speedup over these methods at comparable embedding memory usage.

blocks.zh: 2 相关工作

blocks.en:
Figure 2 : (a) The server encodes audio-visual content, constructs token groups as players, and performs query-agnostic selection to build a compact multimodal memory.
The memory is transferred once to a lightweight device and reused to answer subsequent questions locally.
Selection considers unimodal utility, intra-modal diversity, and cross-modal redundancy.
(b) Video players are formed from spatio-temporal token blocks, while audio players group tokens aligned with the corresponding temporal intervals.
Colors illustrate example groups in each modality.
(c) We estimate each player’s Shapley value by Monte Carlo sampling of player permutations using a weighted coverage function that captures intra-modal diversity through cosine similarity of embeddings (i.e., e e ).
The weights incorporate unimodal utility, derived from token-embedding L2 norms as a proxy for semantic informativeness, and cross-modal redundancy, measured by cosine similarity between players from different modalities.
Players with higher estimated Shapley values are retained, while lower-scoring players are pruned.

blocks.en: 2.1 Multimodal Large Language Models for Video Learning and Understanding
blocks.zh: 2.1 视频学习和理解的多种大型语文模式

blocks.en:
Multimodal large language models (MLLMs) extend language-based interaction to video by integrating visual, temporal, and auditory evidence into a language modeling framework.
A central challenge is to bridge pretrained perceptual encoders and language models while preserving the information required for video captioning, question answering, and event understanding.
Video-LLaMA [ 29 ] introduces modality-specific query transformers to connect visual and audio representations with a language model, enabling instruction-following video understanding grounded in both modalities.
Video-LLaVA [ 17 ] aligns image and video representations before projection into the language space, supporting joint learning from image and video inputs.
To better capture temporal dynamics, VideoLLaMA2 [ 7 ] introduces a spatio-temporal convolutional connector and incorporates an audio branch for audio-visual understanding.
Qwen2.5-Omni [ 26 ] further supports unified text, image, audio, and video understanding, with temporally aligned audio-visual representations for processing multimodal streams.
More recently, video-SALMONN-2 [ 20 ] improves audio-visual captioning through multi-round direct preference optimization and uses the resulting high-quality generated captions for supervised fine-tuning, transferring captioning improvements to video question answering.
Despite their strong performance, these models can incur substantial inference latency and energy consumption when processing long audio-visual sequences.
These costs limit their ability to support rich multimodal experiences on mobile and wearable devices with constrained computing and battery budgets.
blocks.zh:
多式联运大语言模型(MLLMs)通过将视觉,时间,和听觉证据整合到语言模型框架,将基于语言的互动扩展到视频.
一个中心挑战是在保存视频字幕、问答和事件理解所需的信息的同时,搭建预先训练的感知编码器和语言模型。
Video-LLaMA [29] 引入了特定模式的查询变压器,将视觉和音频表达方式与语言模型连接起来,使得基于两种模式的指令跟随视频理解成为可能.
Video-LLaVA [17] 在投影到语言空间之前对图像和视频表现进行校正,支持从图像和视频投入中联合学习.
为了更好地捕捉时间动态,VideoLLaMA2[7]引入了spitio-timperal convolution 连接器,并加入了音频分支,用于视听理解.
Qun2.5-Omni [26] 进一步支持统一文本,图像,音频,视频理解,同时为处理多式联运流提供时间上一致的视听表示.
最近,Video-SALMONN-2[20]通过多轮直接首选优化改进了视听字幕,并利用由此产生的高质量字幕进行有监督的微调,将字幕改进转移到视频问答.
尽管这些模型具有很强的性能,但在处理长长的视听序列时,它们可能会引起大量的推论延迟和能量消耗.
这些费用限制了它们支持在移动和可穿戴设备方面拥有丰富多式经验的能力,其计算和电池预算有限。

blocks.en: 2.2 Token Pruning for Multimodal Large Language Models
blocks.zh: 2.2 多式大型语文模型的托肯冲洗

blocks.en:
Token pruning and merging reduce multimodal inference costs by removing redundant representations.
For image-based MLLMs, existing methods select or compress visual tokens using criteria such as attention, semantic relevance, and diversity [ 31 , 1 , 27 , 30 , 8 , 19 ] .
For video understanding, methods additionally exploit spatial and temporal redundancy [ 14 , 21 , 24 , 11 , 5 ] .
Some further adapt token selection to a given question or the decoding process: PruneVid [ 14 ] combines spatiotemporal merging with question-guided pruning, while DyCoke [ 21 ] performs temporal compression and dynamic KV-cache reduction.
Such question- or decoder-dependent stages cannot be directly applied when a fixed memory must be constructed before future questions are known.
Beyond visual tokens, OmniZip [ 22 ] compresses audio-visual inputs by using audio retention to guide video token allocation and cross-modal similarity to consolidate audio anchors.
We examine a different role for cross-modal similarity: it can indicate duplicated evidence and therefore a reduced benefit from retaining both representations.
Our method downweights cross-modal redundancy while preserving modality-specific utility and unimodal coverage.
This encourages the transferred memory to retain complementary evidence across audio and video within a limited token budget.
blocks.zh:
抽查和合并可以消除多余的表述,从而降低多式联运推论成本。
对于基于图像的MLLM,现有方法使用注意,语义相关性,多样性等标准选择或压缩视觉符号[31, 1, 27, 30, 8, 19].
为了解视频,方法进一步利用空间和时间冗余[14、21、24、11、5]。
某些对象会根据特定的问题或解码程序进一步调整符号选择: 弹簧 vid [14] 结合spatiotemporal 和 问题引导的 pruning 结合,而 DyCoke [21] 则进行时间压缩和动态 KV-cache 递减.
当在知道未来问题之前必须构建固定的内存时,不能直接应用这种问题或解码器依赖阶段.
除了视觉符号,OmniZip [22]通过使用音频保留来对音频输入进行压缩,以引导视频符号分配和跨模式相似来整合音频主播.
我们审查了跨模式相似性的不同作用:它可以表明重复的证据,因此保留这两种表述的好处减少。
我们的方法减少了跨模式冗余,同时保留了特定模式的效用和单模式的覆盖面。
这鼓励转移的内存在有限的象征性预算中保留所有音频和视频的补充证据。

blocks.en: 2.3 Coverage Objectives and Cooperative Valuation
blocks.zh: 2.3 覆盖面目标和合作评价

blocks.en:
Submodular objectives provide a natural language for representative subset selection because they model diminishing returns.
Prior work [ 23 ] on image collection summarization uses functions capturing coverage and diversity.
The Shapley value allocates a game’s total value according to each player’s expected marginal contribution [ 18 ] .
Data Shapley applies this perspective to training-data valuation [ 13 ] .
We instead treat audio-visual token groups as players and evaluate coalitions using a frozen embedding-space surrogate.
This avoids retraining or invoking the language decoder for coalition evaluation.
The role of the Shapley value here is to distribute representational coverage credit among groups, rather than to explain a particular answer or directly measure downstream answer accuracy.
blocks.zh:
子模块目标为代表性子集选择提供了一种自然语言,因为它们的模型是递减回报.
前作[23]关于图像收集的总结使用能够捕捉覆盖和多样性的功能.

blocks.en: 3 Methodology
blocks.zh: 3 方法

blocks.en:
Our method, as illustrated in Fig. 2 , constructs a compact, reusable multimodal memory for server-device inference.
The entire framework is training-free, with all parameters of the audio-visual encoders and the LLM kept frozen.
The server first encodes the input video and audio using frozen modality encoders and organizes their token embeddings into structured players (see Sect. 3.2 ).
Next, we estimate the Shapley value of each player, using an embedding coverage objective that incorporates unimodal utility and cross-modal redundancy.
We select players under the allocated modality budgets and retain their original token embeddings as the memory.
The memory is transferred once to the device, where a lightweight decoder answers subsequent questions using the same stored representation.
This design reduces the multimodal context transmitted and processed locally while keeping user queries on the device.

接下来,我们估计每个玩家的毛值,采用嵌入式覆盖目标,其中包含单式通用和跨式冗余.

blocks.en: 4 Experiments
blocks.zh: 4 实验

blocks.en: 4.1 Experimental Setup
blocks.zh: 4.1 实验设置

blocks.en: 4.1.1 Backbones

We select models with relatively lightweight language decoders to accommodate the memory and computational constraints of user devices in our server–device setting.
We therefore evaluate our method on two audio-visual language models [ 20 ] : video-SALMONN 2+ (3B) and video-SALMONN 2 Pro (4B).
The former builds on Qwen2.5-VL, while the latter adopts Qwen3-VL.
Both models support joint audio-visual understanding and provide pretrained modality encoders and a language decoder.
We apply token selection to their encoded multimodal representations before language decoding, without updating model parameters.
blocks.zh:
我们选择使用相对轻量级语言解码器的模型,以适应我们服务器-device设置中用户设备的内存和计算限制.
因此,我们用两种视听语言模型评价我们的方法:视频-萨尔蒙2+(3B)和视频-萨尔蒙2 Pro(4B)。
前者以Quen2.5-VL为基础,后者采用Qune3-VL.
这两个模型都支持联合视听理解,并提供经过预先训练的模式编码器和语言解码器.
在语言解码之前,我们对其编码的多式表述使用符号选择,而不更新模型参数。

blocks.en: 4.1.2 Benchmarks

We evaluate on Video-MME, Video-Holmes, and Daily-Omni. Video-MME [ 12 ] covers diverse video domains and durations, with 900 videos and 2,700 manually annotated question–answer pairs.
Its short-, medium-, and long-duration subsets allow evaluation across different temporal scales. Video-Holmes [ 6 ] focuses on complex video reasoning, with 1,837 questions spanning seven tasks over 270 suspense short films.
It requires models to locate and connect visual clues across different video segments. Daily-Omni [ 33 ] contains 684 real-world videos and 1,197 multiple-choice questions across six task families.
Its questions emphasize joint audio-visual reasoning and temporal alignment across modalities.
Together, these benchmarks assess general video understanding, reasoning over distributed evidence, and cross-modal information integration.
blocks.zh:
我们通过Video-MME、Video-Holmes和Daily-Omni来评估。 Video-MME [12] 覆盖了不同的视频领域和持续时间,有900个视频和2700个手动注释的问答对联。
它的短、中、长期限子集允许在不同的时间尺度上进行评价。 Video-Holmes [6] 专注于复杂的视频推理,共有1,837个问题涉及7项任务,超过270部悬疑短片.
它需要模型在不同的视频段间定位和连接视觉线索. Daily-Omni [33] 包含684个真实世界视频和1,197个多个选择问题,遍及6个任务家庭.
报告提出的问题强调联合视听推理和不同模式的时间协调。
这些基准共同评估一般的视频理解、对所分发证据的推理以及跨模式信息整合。

blocks.en: 4.1.3 Baselines

We compare against three recent token compression methods published in 2025–2026: DivPrune [ 1 ] , VisionZip [ 27 ] , and OmniZip [ 22 ] .
We adapt their publicly available implementations to our backbones, focusing on methods that can construct compact representations before the user question is available.
Methods requiring query-conditioned selection [ 32 ] are outside this comparison, as they cannot directly support our query-agnostic, one-time-transfer setting.
blocks.zh:
我们比较了最近于2025–2026年发布的三种符号压缩方法:DivPrune [1],VisionZip [27],OmniZip [22].
我们根据我们的骨干,调整其公开实施情况,侧重于在用户问题问出之前构建紧凑表述的方法。
需要以查询条件选择的方法[32]不属于此比较范围,因为它们不能直接支持我们的查询不可知的一次性传输设置。

blocks.en: 4.2 Main Results
blocks.zh: 4.2 主要成果

blocks.en:
Table 1 presents the main results in three benchmarks and two backbones, with unpruned models included as a baseline of the upper-bound.
Our method outperforms existing approaches in most evaluated settings.
For example, on DailyOmni at a pruning ratio of 90 90 % with video-SALMONN 2+ (3B), our method surpasses DivPrune, VisionZip, and OmniZip by 12.03 12.03 , 12.28 12.28 , and 12.61 12.61 percentage points, respectively.
These results demonstrate the effectiveness of our method in preserving task-relevant information under limited token budgets, even at high pruning ratios.
blocks.zh:
表1以三个基准和两个主干部分列出主要结果,未铺设的模型作为上限基线。
在大多数评价环境中,我们的方法比现有方法要好。
例如,在DailyOmni上,以90-90%的速率与视频-SALMONN 2+(3B)比,我们的方法分别比DivPrune、VisionZip和OmniZip高出12.03-12.03、12.28-12.28和12.61-12.61个百分点。
这些结果表明,我们的方法在有限的象征性预算中保留与任务有关的信息是有效的,即使在高比率下也是如此。

To further illustrate the effectiveness of our method, we provide a qualitative comparison with DivPrune, VisionZip, and OmniZip across multiple video frames in Figure 3 .
All methods are evaluated on the Daily-Omni dataset using video-SALMONN 2+ 3B with an identical pruning ratio of 80%.
In this example, DivPrune and VisionZip retain scattered visual regions while discarding much of the content associated with the skateboard and the demonstrator.
OmniZip preserves some relevant regions, but their coverage varies substantially across the displayed frames, with the second frame almost entirely pruned.
In contrast, our method retains the skateboard and the demonstrator’s feet in the first two frames, preserving cues about foot placement relative to the board, while retaining a region covering the demonstrator’s body in the later frame.
These complementary cues across different moments help characterize the skateboarding instruction depicted in the video.
This visualization offers qualitative evidence that our method preserves semantically informative content across both spatial regions and temporal samples under a constrained token budget.
blocks.zh:
为了进一步说明我们的方法的有效性,我们在图3中提供了与DivPrune、VisionZip和OmniZip在多个视频帧上的定性比较。
所有方法都使用视频-SALMONN 2+ 3B在Daily-Omni数据集上进行评价,相同率为80%.
在这个例子中,DivPrune和VisionZip保留了分散的视觉区域,同时丢弃了与滑板和演示器相关的大部分内容.
OmniZip保留了一些相关的区域,但它们的覆盖范围在显示的帧之间差别很大,第二帧几乎完全被铺平.
相比之下,我们的方法保留了前两帧的滑板和显示器脚部,保留了相对于显示器的脚部布置的提示,同时保留了一个覆盖显示器身体的区域。
这些跨越不同时刻的辅助提示有助于描述视频中描绘的滑板教学特征.
这种可视化提供了质的证据表明,我们的方法在有限的象征性预算中保留了空间区域和时间样本的翔实内容。

blocks.en: 4.4 Ablation Studies
blocks.zh: 4.4 阅读研究

blocks.en:
We investigate the sensitivity of our method to the number of Monte Carlo samples used for estimating Shapley values.
As shown in Table 2 , increasing the sampling budget from 16 to 64 improves accuracy from 60.07% to 61.32%.
This improvement is consistent with the reduced estimation uncertainty expected from a larger sampling budget, which can lead to more reliable estimates of token contributions.
Interestingly, further increasing the number of samples to 256 slightly decreases accuracy to 60.57%.
This may be because more accurate Shapley value estimation does not necessarily lead to better token selection for downstream question answering, as our value function serves as a proxy for task-specific utility. Overall, 64 samples achieve the best empirical performance among the evaluated settings while maintaining lower computational overhead than 256 samples.
blocks.zh:
我们调查了我们的方法对用于估计毛细值的蒙特卡洛样本数量的敏感性。
如表2所示,抽样预算从16个增加到64个,准确率从60.07%提高到61.32%。
这一改进与更大的抽样预算预期会减少的估算不确定性相一致,这可以导致对象征性捐款的更可靠的估算。
有趣的是,进一步将样本数量增加到256个,精度略微下降到60.57%.
这可能是因为更准确的Shapley值估计不一定导致下游问题答案的更好符号选择,因为我们的值函数充当了特定任务效用的代名词. 总体而言,64个样本在被评价环境中取得了最佳的经验性业绩,同时维持低于256个样本的计算间接费用。

blocks.en:
We further evaluate the contributions of two proposed weighting items in our value function.
Removing cross-modal redundancy modeling reduces accuracy from 61.32% to 60.99%, suggesting that downweighting redundant information shared between audio and video helps preserve more complementary evidence within a limited memory budget.
Similarly, removing feature utility weighting decreases accuracy to 61.24%, indicating that individual feature informativeness provides an additional signal for token selection.
These results support the effectiveness of combining complementary weighting factors within our value function to construct compact yet informative audio-visual memory.
blocks.zh:
我们进一步评价两个拟议加权项目对我们的价值作用的贡献。
取消跨模式冗余模型将精度从61.32%降至60.99%,这表明音频和视频之间共享的减重冗余信息有助于在有限的内存预算内保存更多的互补证据.
同样,去掉特性功用加权将精度降低到61.24%,表明单个特性的信息性为符号选择提供了额外的信号.
这些成果支持结合我们价值职能中互补的加权因素以构建紧凑但内容翔实的视听记忆的有效性。

blocks.en: 4.5 Efficiency Analysis
blocks.zh: 4.5 效率分析

blocks.en: In this section, we evaluate the efficiency of different methods on the DailyOmni dataset using video-SALMONN 2+ (3B) at an 80% pruning ratio.
blocks.zh: 在本节中,我们评价使用视频-SALMONN 2+(3B)的DailyOmni数据集不同方法的效率,其率为80%。

blocks.en: Since we perform audio-visual token pruning before the LLM, we evaluate the computational efficiency of on-device LLM inference in terms of prefill and decoding latency. As shown in Table 3 , our method achieves the lowest prefill latency of 317.43 ms, delivering an 8.7 × \times speedup over the unpruned baseline (2755.23 ms). It also achieves the lowest decoding latency of 50.71 ms, compared with 91.26–97.32 ms for existing pruning methods, yielding up to a 1.9 × \times speedup. These improvements, together with our strong QA accuracy, demonstrate the effectiveness of our compact audio-visual memory in enabling efficient on-device multimodal understanding.

blocks.en:
Our method substantially reduces the memory footprint of retained input embeddings from 182.33 MiB to 36.90 MiB, achieving a 79.8% reduction over the unpruned baseline.
Notably, the differences in memory footprint between our method and existing pruning approaches are negligible, while our method achieves stronger downstream QA performance (Sec. 4.2 ) by better preserving task-relevant information.
Combined with its superior inference efficiency on the LLM side, as well as consistently competitive, often superior QA accuracy, these results highlight the effectiveness of our approach in balancing computational efficiency and task performance.

值得注意的是,我们的方法与现有穿梭方法在记忆足迹上的差别是微不足道的,而我们的方法通过更好地保存与任务有关的信息,实现了更强的下游质量保证性能(第4.2条)。
这些结果加上其在LLM方面优越的推论效率,以及一贯具有竞争力的、往往优越的质量保证准确性,突出了我们在平衡计算效率和任务业绩方面的做法的有效性。

blocks.en:
Unlike conventional per-query token pruning, our framework targets a server–device scenario in which compact, query-agnostic audio-visual memory is constructed once and reused to answer multiple questions locally.
Since memory construction is independent of user queries, the encoded and pruned representations can be precomputed and cached on the server before any question arrives, following the offline memory preparation paradigm adopted in prior video understanding systems [ 9 , 25 ] .
We therefore exclude server-side encoding and pruning costs from the online latency analysis and focus on memory transmission and device-side inference.

由于内存构建独立于用户查询,在任何问题到达之前,可以按照先前视频理解系统采用的离线内存准备范式[9,25],在服务器上预先计算和缓存编码的表示.
因此,我们将服务器侧编码和推算费用排除在在线延迟分析之外,并侧重于内存传输和设备侧推论。

blocks.en: 5 Conclusion
blocks.zh: 5 结论

blocks.en:
We presented a training-free, query-agnostic framework that constructs compact audio-visual memories for one-time transfer and on-device reuse.
Across evaluated models and benchmarks, our method achieves higher QA accuracy than competing token compression methods by selecting informative and complementary evidence.
Future work can explore more multimodal large language models, detector-based player construction, and Shapley scores as soft supervision for a learnable player selector.
blocks.zh:
我们提出了一个无培训、查询和不可知性框架,构建了用于一次性转让和实时再利用的紧凑视听记忆。
在整个评估模型和基准中,我们的方法通过选择内容丰富和补充性的证据,实现了比相竞争的符号压缩方法更高的质量保证精度。
未来的工作可以探索更多多模式的大型语言模型,基于探测器的玩家构造,以及Shapley分数作为可学习的玩家选择器的软监督.
